_comment: ngsolve plasticity#3 (internal variables sized at the quadrature points). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.5 (6 trigs): the claim's signal 'L2 ndof == num_elements * num_quad_points' is FALSE at every order 1..5 -- L2(order=3) has 10 dofs/element while IntegrationRule(TRIG,3) has 6 points and the collocated rule has 12. ngsolve.comp.IntegrationRuleSpace satisfies the identity exactly for orders 0..5, and it is reachable neither as ngsolve.IntegrationRuleSpace nor via 'from ngsolve import *'.
